data.explanation: Your health insurer needs proof that you are still a student to keep you on the cheaper student rate. Send them the enrolment certificate for the current semester by the deadline shown. If it doesn't arrive in time, your policy will automatically move to the standard (more expensive) rate from February 2027 — this is not a legal deadline but a condition of your policy, so make sure to act before it passes.
